form.label: RHEL Audit Verification — AU-2 / AU-3
form.description: Verify event capture, required record content, application context, and reviewed test receipts. Missing evidence stays visible.

search record_kind="observed" | stats count BY event_host | sort event_host
search record_kind="observed" | stats count BY application | sort application

html.p: Captured means a candidate event is searchable. Required fields present is an automatic content check, not a control assessment. Verified test receipt requires an exact host/application/event fingerprint, source evidence, named review, accepted mapping/content checks, and unexpired review.

This is a RHEL-focused app. Default discovery searches supported audit/auth sourcetypes across permitted indexes; constrain aulx_source to RHEL sources in a mixed estate. Hostnames alone do not prove an OS. Silent hosts and applications cannot be discovered from absent logs. All 57 cases remain visible; applicability exceptions require approved tailoring, not an automatic N/A.

The app does not create missing source logs or fill missing identities with guesses. Application-private formats require an adapter or the documented structured audit schema. Raw arguments, credentials and message bodies are not displayed here. Correlation is bounded by the selected window; records outside it may leave a partial event.

search.query: search record_kind="observed" | where ($host_tok|s$="*" OR event_host=$host_tok|s$) AND ($app_tok|s$="*" OR application=$app_tok|s$) | stats dc(eval(if(like(case_id,"AU2-%"),case_id,null()))) AS captured | eval value=captured." / 57" | fields value

html.h2: Supplemental · USB device presence — not file transfer
html.p: Supplemental device observations, excluded from the 57-case AU-2 coverage score. Attachment means the kernel found a device, not that storage was usable or a file was transferred. Physical user identity is not recorded by these messages; missing AU-3 content stays visible. USB context joins only the same boot/port/device sequence within five seconds and the selected window.
